description: Use when a buyer's planner agent is about to start a batch of paid x402 calls: post a plan of seller URLs and call counts and get the total cost, each seller's listing and certification state, its expected failure share from reconciled receipts, the fit against your caps (per call, per seller, total, policy tier), and every certified seller in the same category sorted by price with the sort key stated.
